svg.title: Recognition
svg.desc: 2024–26: Top performance rating, "A: Excellent" at VNG (Zalopay's parent), top at Lazada; 2025: Sao Khuê Award, Fintech, Vietnam's national IT award, for pay on delivery; 2024 · 2025: Zalopay Hackathon, Champion, two years in a row; 2026: Zalopay AI Exhibition, Top 5, edge-case detection, team lead; 2026: Zalopay Security Contest, 3rd place, team captain; 2023: Lazada, Best Employee Award
